description.zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID。
description.en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh: API调用时间，格式为**EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**。
description.en: The time when the operation is called. The format is: **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**.

description.zh: 限定此次返回资源的数量。取值范围[0,100]，默认值为20。返回结果小于或等于指定的数量。
description.en: The maximum number of resources to return. Valid values: \[0,100]. Default value: 20. The number of returned results is less than or equal to the specified number.

description.zh: 当符合查询条件的数据未读取完时，服务端会返回nextToken，此时可以使用nextToken继续读取后面的数据。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数。
description.en: The pagination token to use to request the next page of results. If the number of resources exceeds the limit, the nextToken parameter is returned. You can include the parameter in subsequent calls to obtain more results. You do not need to provide this parameter in the first call.
The prefix that the returned domain names must contain.

description.zh: 设定结果从startKey之后（包括startKey）按字母排序的第一个开始返回。
description.en: The returned resources are sorted in alphabetical order, and the resources that include and follow the resource specified by the startKey parameter are returned.

title.zh: 获取自定义域名列表信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc-open list-custom-domains --prefix prefix_text --start-key next_service --next-token fc-thinkphp-demo.functioncompute.com --limit 20 --x-fc-account-id 1880770869020000 --x-fc-date Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT --x-fc-trace-id asdf00000 --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun fc-open GET /2021-04-06/custom-domains --region cn-hangzhou --startKey next_service --prefix prefix_text --nextToken 'fc-thinkphp-demo.functioncompute.com' --limit 20 --header "X-Fc-Date=Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT" --header "X-Fc-Trace-Id=asdf00000" --header "X-Fc-Account-Id=1880770869020000" --header "Content-Type=application/json"
